long_biography.plain_text:
At 17, Steve Firestone led an extended expedition before beginning a 15-year career in the computer sector. Somera credits those ventures with producing substantial wealth for him and his family. He also placed his own money and family-account capital into western United States property. In 1994, he organized Somera Real Estate Group to select projects, structure partnerships and manage the resulting investments.

That business evolved into Somera Capital Management, co-founded with property investor David Brown. Firestone now directs investment selection, corporate strategy and financial oversight as its founder and board chair. He holds ownership and executive interests in Somera and has served as a managing member within affiliated structures, although his percentage interest is undisclosed. Separately owned family trusts must remain outside his balance sheet. Likewise, capital entrusted by investors, aggregate equity deployed and property handled through Somera belong to funds, partners or underlying entities, not automatically to Firestone.
